summary: Single-vehicle rollover off Highway 550 (Red Mountain Pass), just south of Ouray; vehicle about 130 feet down an embankment. Two Blackhawk residents, Darrell and Teresa Foster: Darrell had no serious injuries, Teresa was transported for care. OMRT, OVFD and OCEMS performed a rope litter evacuation over a steep scree hillside.
location: Highway 550, Red Mountain Pass, just south of Ouray
notes: Two OMRT posts describe the same 2018-12-26 mission (2018-12-27 post: 'last night'; 2019-01-04 post: 'December 26 mission').
